channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar recovers modestly as markets assess developments in Mideast
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, August 25:

item.title: Euro remains depressed against British Pound despite upbeat German GDP figures
item.description: The Euro (EUR) extends losses for the fourth consecutive day against the British Pound (GBP) on Tuesday, testing weekly lows in the 0.8550 area despite the upward revision to German Q2 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) earlier in the day.

item.title: Swiss Franc: Export strains with strong CHF – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister analyses how the strong Swiss Franc (CHF) and an undervalued Chinese Yuan (CNY) are weighing on Switzerland’s export competitiveness.

item.title: Indian Rupee edges up against US Dollar on possible RBI’s intervention
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) in the opening session on Tuesday.

item.title: WTI slides below $84.00 on firmer USD but US-Iran tensions limit deeper losses
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – attracts fresh sellers following an intraday uptick to the $85.35 region and turns lower for the second straight day. The commodity slides below $84.00 during the early European session, though the downside potential seems limited.

item.title: Australian Dollar edges up as RBA keeps rate hike option quite possible
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades slightly higher against its major currency peers, except the US Dollar (USD), on Tuesday. In the European session, the Aussie pair is slightly down to near 0.7147.

item.title: Equities: Semiconductor selloff pressures Wall Street - Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists describe a cautious session for United States (US) equities, with the S&P 500 slipping as AI‑chip names sold off ahead of Nvidia’s earnings. While the equal‑weighted S&P approached record highs, headline indices were dragged lower by semiconductor weakness.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: US Dollar keeps crawling towards the key 160.00 area
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) remains on the defensive against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, in a low-volatility market, as investors await key data releases and the Jackson Hole symposium, due in the second half of the week, to make decisions.

item.title: US Dollar: Data weakness keeps downside risks elevated - TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities strategists argue that the US Dollar (USD) has re-entered a bearish regime after the Treasury buyback announcement pushed the US Dollar Index (DXY) below its 200‑day SMA.

item.title: Euro: Further gains eyed toward 1.1800 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann keep a constructive stance on EUR/USD despite recent consolidation around 1.1660. They still see room for upside toward 1.1725 in the coming weeks as long as support at 1.1630 holds.

item.title: Gold sticks to modest losses below $4,650 as Fed risks and Middle East tensions lift USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) stabilizes below $4,650 heading into the European session, stalling its intraday retracement slide from the $4,700 neighborhood, or the highest since May 14, touched earlier this Tuesday.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Corrects further as US Dollar extends recovery
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades marginally lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, extending its corrective move from the four-day high of 1.1711 to near 1.1655 during the European trading session.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah struggles amid record deficit, external pressures
item.description: USD/IDR halts its three-day losing streak, trading around 17,770 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair appreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) struggles under the weight of cautious market sentiment driven by persistent external pressures.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Rises toward 186.00 after rebounding from ascending channel bottom
item.description: EUR/JPY appreciates after two days of gains, trading around 185.80 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. Technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the currency cross remains within the ascending channel pattern, signaling an ongoing bullish bias.

item.title: Canadian Dollar remains depressed as firmer USD and trade war counter higher oil prices
item.description: The USD/CAD pair sticks to a positive bias for the second straight day and trades around mid-1.3800s during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: RBA's Jacobs: Transition from RBA controlling reserves quantity to banking system managing it
item.description: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Head of Domestic Markets, David Jacobs, said during the Asian trading session on Tuesday that the central bank aims to have a system that can flexibly supply whatever quantity the banking system demands, while keeping the cash rate close to the board’s target.

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds gains near 99.00 amid escalating geopolitical risks
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is extending its gains for the second successive day and trading around 99.00 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD corrects below $68 in countdown to US PCE Inflation data
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is down 1.6% to near $67.87 during the Asian trading session on Tuesday. The white metal is under pressure as investors turn cautious ahead of the United States (US) Personal Consumer Expenditure Price Index (PCE) data for July, which will be released on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound holds range below mid-1.3600s as USD firms amid Fed risks and Iran tensions
item.description: The GBP/USD pair extends its sideways consolidative price move for the second straight day and trades around the 1.3630 area during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar gains as high inflation fuels odds of RBNZ September rate hikes
item.description: NZD/USD gains ground after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around 0.5960 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama: Will focus on key policies in FY27 budget to drive economic growth
item.description: Japan Finance Minister (FM) Satsuki Katayama said in the Asian trading session on Tuesday that the government aims to balance fiscal sustainability and economic growth and communicate with markets on this stance.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains steady following RBA Meeting Minutes
item.description: AUD/USD gains ground after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around 0.7150 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: WTI holds ground above $84.50 as escalating concerns over US sanctions on Iran
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price appreciates after registering over 2% losses in the previous day, trading around $84.70 per barrel during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: RBA Minutes: Board ready to raise rates if upside risks materialise
item.description: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) published the Minutes of its July monetary policy meeting on Tuesday, with the key takeaways noted below.

item.title: Iran’s Economy Minister Madanizadeh: Enemies should wait for an attack
item.description: Iranian Economy Minister Ali Madanizadeh said on Tuesday, "We are fully prepared for the US sanctions."

item.title: Japanese Yen consolidates around 159.00 vs USD as bearish potential remains intact
item.description: The USD/JPY pair is seen oscillating in a narrow band just above the 159.00 mark during the Asian session on Tuesday, awaiting a fresh catalyst before the next leg of a directional move.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7852 vs. 6.7841 previous
item.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead on Tuesday at 6.7852 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7841 and 6.7219 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Euro gains support amid hawkish ECB expectations, subdued US Dollar
item.description: EUR/USD inches higher after posting minor losses in the previous day, trading around 1.1670 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair finds support as rising oil prices, elevated bond yields, and escalating Middle East tensions drive Eurozone inflation concerns.

item.title: Australian Dollar falls as Iran sanctions sour risk appetite, RBA minutes eyed
item.description: The Australian Dollar began the week on a lower note, trading with a 0.28% loss against the Greenback as risk appetite soured after the US Department of the Treasury imposed sanctions on Iran-linked entities. At the time of writing, the pair trades at 0.7159
